During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] known as [[Abek's Station]] was '''destroyed''' by the [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] ''[[Ion Storm]]'', under the command of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Surlev]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Surlev was searching for the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Limna Yith]], who had been leaving a trail of [[Blood/Legends|blood]] and destruction throughout the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]]. When he tracked her to the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], he received approval from [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Skreeg]] to destroy it. He did so, but Yith escaped.<ref name="TBC" />
